name: Symmetric;Vision
source:
“All for the sake of Love and Science.”

By pure accident, detective girl Takeuchi Ayane comes across "VIEW Gen" victim Sano Hinata. Follow the clues while uncovering the truth of his death.

With the ability “Future Preview,” put out the embers of disaster before they ignite.
Yet, behind the web of incidents, the one pulling the strings is…?

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2865540/]Steam[/url]]
